note: Hand-curated landmark set for the Philadelphia 3D topographic map. Coordinates are rounded to ~10 m and chosen for geographic legibility (where a place sits in the terrain), not for survey accuracy. Elevations are not stored here: the app samples them from the same DEM as the terrain surface, so a landmark's readout can never disagree with the ground it sits on. 'since' (optional) is the year a landmark came to exist, so era views can hide labels for things that were not there yet.
rank: 1 = always shown, 2 = mid density, 3 = dense only
